name: Tata Consultancy Services
description: India's largest IT services company and a global leader in technology solutions, consulting, and business process services across 150+ locations in 46 countries.
history: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) was founded in 1968 as a division of Tata Sons Limited, making it one of the oldest IT companies in India. Under the visionary leadership of F.C. Kohli, often called the 'father of the Indian IT industry,' TCS pioneered the concept of IT services outsourcing. The company went public in 2004 with India's largest IPO at the time, raising $1.2 billion. Today, TCS is a $200+ billion market cap company and a key pillar of the Tata Group.

milestones.text: Founded as a division of Tata Sons in Mumbai
First international client — Burroughs (now Unisys)
Established India's first dedicated software research center
IPO on BSE/NSE — India's largest at the time ($1.2B)
Became the first Indian IT company to cross $100 billion market cap
Crossed $200 billion market cap milestone
Named among world's most valuable IT brands globally

interviewProcess: TCS conducts its recruitment through TCS National Qualifier Test (NQT). The process typically has 3 stages: (1) TCS NQT — an online aptitude and technical test, (2) Technical Interview — covering programming concepts, projects, and CS fundamentals, and (3) HR Interview — assessing communication, company fit, and career goals.

sections.description: Pseudo code, output prediction, basic coding

tips: Focus heavily on Quantitative Aptitude — it carries the most weight in NQT
Practice pseudo-code based questions as they're unique to TCS pattern
Time management is critical — divide time proportionally across sections
Brush up on basic data structures and sorting algorithms
Read TCS-specific coding questions from previous year papers
Communication skills matter a lot in the interview rounds

name: Google (Alphabet Inc.)
description: The world's most popular search engine and one of the most influential technology companies, building products used by billions including Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome, and Google Cloud.
history: Google was founded in 1998 by Larry Page and Sergey Brin while they were Ph.D. students at Stanford University. What started as a research project on web search algorithms became the world's dominant search engine. The company went public in 2004 and restructured under Alphabet Inc. in 2015. Google has shaped the modern internet and continues to push boundaries in AI, quantum computing, and autonomous vehicles.

milestones.text: Founded by Larry Page and Sergey Brin at Stanford
IPO at $85/share — valued at $23 billion
Acquired Android Inc., launching Android OS in 2008
Acquired YouTube for $1.65 billion
Restructured under Alphabet Inc.
Launched Gemini AI model, revolutionizing AI landscape
Crossed $2 trillion market capitalization

interviewProcess: Google's interview process is highly rigorous: (1) Resume Screening and Online Assessment, (2) Phone/Video Screen — 1-2 coding interviews, (3) On-site Interviews — 4-5 rounds covering coding, algorithms, system design (for senior roles), and Googleyness & Leadership. Interviewers evaluate problem-solving approach, not just the correct answer.

sections.name: Phone Screen (Coding)
sections.description: Live coding with interviewer, DSA focused

sections.name: On-site: Coding (x2-3)
sections.description: Complex algorithm and data structure problems

tips: Master data structures: trees, graphs, hash maps, heaps, and tries
Practice on LeetCode medium-hard problems — aim for 200+ solved
Think aloud during interviews — process matters more than just the answer
Study time and space complexity deeply — always analyze Big O
For system design, understand distributed systems, caching, and load balancing
Google values 'Googleyness' — be collaborative, curious, and humble

dayToDayDuties: Design and implement efficient algorithms in C++, Java, Python, or Go
Write robust unit, integration, and performance test suites
Participate in sprint planning, architectural design discussions, and code reviews
Monitor production deployments, analyze error logs, and optimize database queries

Month 4: Timed 45-minute mock interviews explaining Big-O time and space trade-offs out loud

Round 2: Technical Phone Screen with Senior Engineer (Live DSA Coding)
Round 3: Onsite Problem Solving Round 1 (Trees, Graphs, Recursion)

name: International Business Machines
description: A historic technology company that has reinvented itself multiple times over a century. IBM is now focused on hybrid cloud and AI, with its watsonx platform and Red Hat acquisition driving modern enterprise transformation.
history: IBM traces its origins to 1911 as the Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company, renamed IBM in 1924. The company shaped the modern computing era — from the first hard drive and the personal computer to Deep Blue defeating chess champion Garry Kasparov. Under Arvind Krishna's leadership, IBM has pivoted to hybrid cloud and AI, anchored by the $34 billion acquisition of Red Hat in 2019.

milestones.text: Founded as Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company
Renamed to International Business Machines (IBM)
IBM PC launched — sparked the personal computer revolution
Deep Blue defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov
Watson wins Jeopardy! — AI breakthrough moment
Acquired Red Hat for $34 billion
Launched watsonx AI platform for enterprises

interviewProcess: IBM campus hiring: (1) Online Assessment (AMCAT-based) — Cognitive, English, Technical, and Coding, (2) Technical Interview — CS fundamentals, cloud concepts, and project discussion, (3) HR Interview — behavioral assessment and role fit. IBM also offers specialized roles through the 'CbS' and 'ISA' hiring tracks.

sections.name: Technical (CS Fundamentals)
sections.description: Programming, DBMS, OS, cloud computing basics

sections.name: Coding
sections.description: Medium-level programming problems in any language

tips: IBM's cognitive ability section has strict time limits — practice speed
Cloud computing basics are increasingly important — learn AWS/Azure/IBM Cloud
IBM values innovation and research — mention relevant academic research/projects
Reading comprehension passages can be long — skim effectively for answers
Java is IBM's preferred language — brush up on core Java concepts
The essay section tests clarity of thought — structure your response well

ctcBreakdown.benefits: Free Health Insurance, Hybrid Work Allowance, Wellness Subsidies

jobRoles.jobDescription: As an entry-level SDE at Nubank, you will write high-quality, production-ready code for scalable distributed cloud systems. You will collaborate with senior staff engineers, participate in code reviews, design microservices, and deploy real features used by millions of global users daily.
dayToDayDuties: Design and implement efficient algorithms in C++, Java, Python, or Go
Write robust unit, integration, and performance test suites
Participate in sprint planning, architectural design discussions, and code reviews
Monitor production deployments, analyze error logs, and optimize database queries
Work with cross-functional product managers and designers to launch customer features
prepRoadmap: Month 1: Master Arrays, Two Pointers, Hash Maps, and Binary Search (Solve 75+ medium problems)
Month 2: Binary Trees, BSTs, Graph Traversals (BFS/DFS), and Heap priority queues
Month 3: Dynamic Programming patterns, String algorithms, and basic Object-Oriented Design
Month 4: Timed 45-minute mock interviews explaining Big-O time and space trade-offs out loud
interviewRounds: Round 1: Online Coding Screen (2 Algorithmic Problems, 70-90 min)
Round 2: Technical Phone Screen with Senior Engineer (Live DSA Coding)
Round 3: Onsite Problem Solving Round 1 (Trees, Graphs, Recursion)
Round 4: Onsite Problem Solving Round 2 (Algorithms & Data Structures)
Round 5: Behavioral & Cultural Fit Interview (Leadership Principles)

jobRoles.title: Associate Cloud & Systems Engineer (Fresher Trainee)
jobRoles.fresherEligibility: Any Engineering or Science Degree (B.Tech, B.E, B.Sc, BCA, MCA). No strict cut-off if technical skills are demonstrated.
jobRoles.jobDescription: Support Nubank's global cloud infrastructure and automated reliability pipelines. You will configure container environments, monitor service health, build observability dashboards, and automate deployment workflows.
dayToDayDuties: Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Docker containers
Monitor server latency, CPU utilization, and error rates using Datadog/Prometheus
Write automated test and build pipelines in GitHub Actions or Jenkins
Troubleshoot Linux OS network connections, DNS resolution, and SSL certificates
Participate in blameless post-mortem analysis for system anomalies
prepRoadmap: Week 1-2: Master Linux command line, process inspection, file permissions, and shell scripting
Week 3-4: Computer Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, Subnetting)
Week 5-6: Docker containerization and writing simple multi-stage Dockerfiles
Week 7-8: Practice infrastructure troubleshooting scenarios and basic coding questions
interviewRounds: Round 1: Cognitive Aptitude & Linux/Networking MCQs
Round 2: Practical Scripting & Debugging Assessment
Round 3: Systems Fundamentals & Problem Solving Interview
Round 4: HR & Cultural Alignment Round

interviewRounds: Round 1: Systems & Networking MCQs + Coding Assessment
Round 2: Live Linux & Systems Troubleshooting
Round 3: Distributed Systems Architecture

preparationLevels.intermediate: ⚡ Level 2: Intermediate — Campus placement standard, DSA fundamentals, OOP, SQL

interviewProcess: Nubank recruits via technical assessments and multiple rounds of algorithmic coding, system design, and behavioral evaluations.

sections.name: Technical & Coding
sections.description: Algorithms, data structures, and computer science concepts

tips: Master the core technology stack used at Nubank
Focus on system reliability, clean architecture, and scalability
Practice algorithmic problem solving on LeetCode medium-to-hard level
Read Nubank's engineering blogs to understand their architectural challenges
